name: base_utils
description: Foundation utility module providing cross-platform helper functions, custom facts, defined types, and Bolt orchestration tasks.

name: profile::base::base
description: Base operating system profile applied to all node types handling common system services including NTP time synchronization via chrony, rsyslog configuration, and integration with base_utils module.

name: profile_app_stack
description: Full-stack Python web application deployment with PostgreSQL database, systemd service management, and comprehensive logging.

name: profile::app::stack
description: Thin wrapper profile that delegates to profile_app_stack module, providing environment-aware indirection layer following roles/profiles pattern.

name: profile_haproxy
description: Enterprise HAProxy load balancer with multi-level Hiera hierarchy, dynamic backend discovery via PuppetDB queries, SSL/TLS termination, and datacenter-aware configuration.

name: profile::loadbalancer::haproxy
description: Thin wrapper profile that delegates to profile_haproxy module with environment fact awareness.

name: profile_postgresql
description: PostgreSQL database server installation with PGDG repository management for version pinning, supporting Debian/Ubuntu platforms with version-specific package installation.

name: profile_redis_cluster
description: Redis cluster deployment using puppet-redis module with PuppetDB-based node discovery for cluster membership and custom Facter fact for role detection.

name: role::app_server
description: Composite role combining base profile, HAProxy, application stack, and Redis cache for a full application server node.

name: role::app_stack
description: Application stack node role (Python app + PostgreSQL) with base profile and strict dependency ordering.

name: role::haproxy
description: HAProxy load balancer node role combining base OS profile with HAProxy-specific configuration.

name: role::redis_cluster
description: Redis cluster node role with base profile and cache profile composition.

name: puppetdb_query_stub
description: Development stub for PuppetDB query function that returns empty arrays when PuppetDB is unavailable, enabling local testing without PuppetDB infrastructure.
